77: 	private static final char[] CHECK_NOT_NULL = "checkNotNull".toCharArray();

82: 		for (EclipseNode m : method.down()) {
83: 			if (m.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) continue;
84: 			for (EclipseNode c : m.down()) {
85: 				if (c.getKind() == Kind.ANNOTATION) {

94: 	private List<FieldDeclaration> getRecordComponents(EclipseNode typeNode) {
95: 		List<FieldDeclaration> list = new ArrayList<FieldDeclaration>();
96: 		
97: 		for (EclipseNode child : typeNode.down()) {
98: 			if (child.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
99: 				FieldDeclaration fd = (FieldDeclaration) child.get();
100: 				if ((fd.modifiers & AccRecord) != 0) list.add(fd);
101: 			}
102: 		}
103: 		
104: 		return list;
105: 	}

107: 	private EclipseNode addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(EclipseNode typeNode, EclipseNode annotationNode) {
108: 		// explicit Compact Constructor has bits set: Bit32, IsCanonicalConstructor (10).
109: 		// implicit Compact Constructor has bits set: Bit32, IsCanonicalConstructor (10), and IsImplicit (11).
110: 		// explicit constructor with long-form shows up as a normal constructor (Bit32 set, that's all), but the
111: 		//   implicit CC is then also present and will presumably be stripped out in some later phase.
112: 		
113: 		EclipseNode toRemove = null;
114: 		EclipseNode existingCompactConstructor = null;
115: 		List<FieldDeclaration> recordComponents = null;
116: 		for (EclipseNode child : typeNode.down()) {
117: 			if (!(child.get() instanceof ConstructorDeclaration)) continue;
118: 			ConstructorDeclaration cd = (ConstructorDeclaration) child.get();
119: 			if ((cd.bits & IsCanonicalConstructor) != 0) {
120: 				if ((cd.bits & IsImplicit) != 0) {
121: 					toRemove = child;
122: 				} else {
123: 					existingCompactConstructor = child;
124: 				}
125: 			} else {
126: 				// If this constructor has exact matching types vs. the record components,
127: 				// this is the canonical constructor in long form and we should not generate one.
128: 				
129: 				if (recordComponents == null) recordComponents = getRecordComponents(typeNode);
130: 				int argLength = cd.arguments == null ? 0 : cd.arguments.length;
131: 				int compLength = recordComponents.size();
132: 				boolean isCanonical = argLength == compLength;
133: 				if (isCanonical) top: for (int i = 0; i < argLength; i++) {
134: 					TypeReference a = recordComponents.get(i).type;
135: 					TypeReference b = cd.arguments[i] == null ? null : cd.arguments[i].type;
136: 					// technically this won't match e.g. `java.lang.String` to just `String`;
137: 					// to use this feature you'll need to use the same way to write it, which seems
138: 					// like a fair requirement.
139: 					char[][] ta = getRawTypeName(a);
140: 					char[][] tb = getRawTypeName(b);
141: 					if (ta == null || tb == null || ta.length != tb.length) {
142: 						isCanonical = false;
143: 						break top;
144: 					}
145: 					for (int j = 0; j < ta.length; j++) {
146: 						if (!Arrays.equals(ta[j], tb[j])) {
147: 							isCanonical = false;
148: 							break top;
149: 						}
150: 					}
151: 				}
152: 				if (isCanonical) {
153: 					return null;
154: 				}
155: 			}
156: 		}
157: 		if (existingCompactConstructor != null) return existingCompactConstructor;
158: 		int posToInsert = -1;
159: 		TypeDeclaration td = (TypeDeclaration) typeNode.get();
160: 		if (toRemove != null) {
161: 			int idxToRemove = -1;
162: 			for (int i = 0; i < td.methods.length; i++) {
163: 				if (td.methods[i] == toRemove.get()) idxToRemove = i;
164: 			}
165: 			if (idxToRemove != -1) {
166: 				System.arraycopy(td.methods, idxToRemove + 1, td.methods, idxToRemove, td.methods.length - idxToRemove - 1);
167: 				posToInsert = td.methods.length - 1;
168: 				typeNode.removeChild(toRemove);
169: 			}
170: 		}
171: 		if (posToInsert == -1) {
172: 			AbstractMethodDeclaration[] na = new AbstractMethodDeclaration[td.methods.length + 1];
173: 			posToInsert = td.methods.length;
174: 			System.arraycopy(td.methods, 0, na, 0, posToInsert);
175: 			td.methods = na;
176: 		}
177: 		
178: 		ConstructorDeclaration cd = new ConstructorDeclaration(((CompilationUnitDeclaration) typeNode.top().get()).compilationResult);
179: 		cd.modifiers = ClassFileConstants.AccPublic;
180: 		cd.bits = ASTNode.Bit32 | ECLIPSE_DO_NOT_TOUCH_FLAG | IsCanonicalConstructor;
181: 		cd.selector = td.name;
182: 		cd.constructorCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.ImplicitSuper);
183: 		if (recordComponents == null) recordComponents = getRecordComponents(typeNode);
184: 		cd.arguments = new Argument[recordComponents.size()];
185: 		cd.statements = new Statement[recordComponents.size()];
186: 		cd.bits = IsCanonicalConstructor;
187: 		
188: 		for (int i = 0; i < cd.arguments.length; i++) {
189: 			FieldDeclaration cmp = recordComponents.get(i);
190: 			cd.arguments[i] = new Argument(cmp.name, cmp.sourceStart, cmp.type, 0);
191: 			cd.arguments[i].bits = ASTNode.IsArgument | ASTNode.IgnoreRawTypeCheck | ASTNode.IsReachable;
192: 			FieldReference lhs = new FieldReference(cmp.name, 0);
193: 			lhs.receiver = new ThisReference(0, 0);
194: 			SingleNameReference rhs = new SingleNameReference(cmp.name, 0);
195: 			cd.statements[i] = new Assignment(lhs, rhs, cmp.sourceEnd);
196: 		}
197: 		
198: 		setGeneratedBy(cd, annotationNode.get());
199: 		for (int i = 0; i < cd.arguments.length; i++) {
200: 			FieldDeclaration cmp = recordComponents.get(i);
201: 			cd.arguments[i].sourceStart = cmp.sourceStart;
202: 			cd.arguments[i].sourceEnd = cmp.sourceStart;
203: 			cd.arguments[i].declarationSourceEnd = cmp.sourceStart;
204: 			cd.arguments[i].declarationEnd = cmp.sourceStart;
205: 		}
206: 		
207: 		td.methods[posToInsert] = cd;
208: 		cd.annotations = addSuppressWarningsAll(typeNode, cd, cd.annotations);
209: 		cd.annotations = addGenerated(typeNode, cd, cd.annotations);
210: 		return typeNode.add(cd, Kind.METHOD);
211: 	}
